purpose: Safety and governance map for ARC reviewer system

ZONE_CORE.description: Critical system logic, routing, and configuration. Changes here can alter behavior, security, or data flow.
rules: Changes are NOT allowed without explicit override
Never refactor for tone, style, or readability

ZONE_OUTPUT.description: User-facing UI and text. Logic and intent must remain unchanged.
rules: Tone, wording, and formatting may be adjusted
Must not change behavior, intent, or data flow
No side effects, no branching logic

ZONE_DEV.description: Development-only files, backups, and tools not used in production runtime.
rules: Must not be imported into production code

reviewer_instructions: Reject any proposal that modifies ZONE_CORE unless explicitly overridden
Approve ZONE_OUTPUT changes if intent and logic remain unchanged
ZONE_DEV changes are allowed but must stay isolated
If a proposal spans multiple zones, default to SAFE: NO
